$comment: Pinned client files for Cobblemon on Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric), mirrored from the official "Cobblemon Official Modpack [Fabric]". Every file is fetched from the official Modrinth CDN and its SHA-512 is verified before it is placed. The jars are deliberately NOT committed here: they are third-party binaries (some under licences that forbid rehosting) and Cobblemon alone is 133 MB, over GitHub's 100 MB per-file limit. "folder" is where the file goes inside the game folder, "core" marks the two files needed for a bare-bones install (-Minimal), "server" marks the files this same manifest puts on the Minecraft server.
